answer: Require each agent to post a refundable bond before trading, forfeited if peers prove fraud. A sybil attacker must fund every fake identity, so creating thousands costs thousands of bonds, while honest agents recover theirs. Like a comet leaving a visible trail, past behaviour stays linked to the bond; a willow bends but keeps its roots, and honest history accumulates trust. A falcon cannot fake a flock cheaply when each bird must stake its own funds.
